verdict: GoDaddy grew revenue 6% to $1.34B but profit 24% to $262M, as its higher-value Applications & Commerce business grew 9% and total costs barely moved.

segments.name: Core Platform
segments.note: Domains, hosting and the core presence platform for GoDaddy's 20.5M customers.

segments.name: Applications & Commerce
segments.note: Websites, email, commerce and the Airo AI builder — the faster-growing, higher-value layer on top of domains; Airo's annualized bookings run rate passed $100M.

opex.name: Technology & development
opex.note: Engineering and maintaining the platform, including the Airo AI tools.

opex.name: Marketing & advertising
opex.note: Advertising and marketing to win new entrepreneurs.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The back office: finance, legal and administration.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $37.7M, partly offset by $7.8M of other income.

takeaways.title: Operating leverage did the work
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 22% to $362M — a 27% margin — on just 6% revenue growth, because costs and operating expenses in total rose only about 1%.

takeaways.title: Airo is becoming real
takeaways.text: The Airo AI website builder's annualized bookings run rate exceeded $100M, more than doubling in one quarter, and GoDaddy launched agent-friendly APIs for hosting, email and commerce.

takeaways.title: The customer base inched up
takeaways.text: Total customers reached 20.5M, up 40 thousand in the quarter — growth now comes mainly from selling more to each customer (Applications & Commerce) rather than adding users.
